title: Canonical container identity grammar conformance
test_intent: Determine whether a governed information-container identity conforms to the canonical seven-token cross-platform grammar without relying on a platform-specific alternate identity scheme.

applicability.applies_when: A governed information container is assigned or validated for enterprise, CDE, coordination, exchange, or handover use.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested object is not a governed information container identity subject to S4.

required_evidence: parsed token sequence and file extension
governed token vocabulary or validation source used for each token

result_logic.pass: The identity parses into exactly the governed project, originator, volume/system, level/location, type, role, and number tokens in the prescribed order, with the governed delimiter and extension treatment, and no alternate canonical grammar is asserted.
result_logic.fail: The identity cannot be parsed into the required seven-token grammar, uses an alternate root identity grammar, or omits/reorders a required identity token.
result_logic.not_applicable: The subject is outside the governed information-container identity scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The identity string is available but one or more governing token vocabularies or scope declarations required to judge conformance are unavailable.

provenance.migration_note: First conformance pilot ATS derived directly from the existing S4 requirement. Tool-neutral by design.
